تستفرغون (form X)
# تَسْتَفْرِغُونَ (tastafriḡūna) /tas.taf.ri.ɣuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَفْرَغَ (istafraḡa)
# تُسْتَفْرَغُونَ (tustafraḡūna) /tus.taf.ra.ɣuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَفْرَغَ (istafraḡa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
